data.body:
Remediation pushed to Gerrit change 2986.

Worktree: `/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.rebar/worktrees/fix-0eba-semlock`
Commit: `c3308e3b757861aa50f81604e7d3341a975fa69c`
Change-Id: `Id749baff3ae5ad0d02362d3788401a882a521f01`
Gerrit: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2986

Identified the 4 affected tests by observation with:

```sh
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q -p no:xdist \
  tests/unit/test_network_guard_local_ipc.py::test_network_guard_allows_forkserver_multiprocessing \
  tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py::test_two_processes_publish_at_most_one_equivalent_same_ticket_bundle \
  tests/unit/test_marker_fcntl_guard.py::test_marker_lock_serializes_posix_access \
  tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor_locks.py::test_a_contended_fcntl_leg_reads_as_held
```

Observed output before the fix: all 4 failed at CPython `multiprocessing/synchronize.py` constructing `_multiprocessing.SemLock`, with `PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted`.

Implemented:
- Added an operation-based POSIX named semaphore probe in `tests/_sandbox_capabilities.py`.
- Added marker-driven counted skipping in `tests/conftest.py`.
- Marked exactly these 4 multiprocessing-contract tests with `requires_posix_named_semaphore`.
- Added `tests/test_sandbox_capabilities_0eba.py` for denied, available, counted-summary, and available-marker behavior.
- Documented local sandbox-vs-hosted verification behavior and the non-role of worker count in `docs/local-dev-env.md`.

Acceptance evidence:

```sh
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q -p no:xdist tests/test_sandbox_capabilities_0eba.py
```

Output: `4 passed in 0.84s`.

```sh
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q -p no:xdist tests/test_sandbox_capabilities_0eba.py [4 affected nodeids]
```

Output:

```text
....ssss                                                                  [100%]
------------------------ sandbox compatibility skips: 4 ------------------------
POSIX named semaphore unavailable: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted: 4
4 passed, 4 skipped in 55.43s
```

This asserts unavailable-on-EPERM, available-on-success, available marker path runs instead of skipping, and counted summary reports 4.

Constant-stub proof:

Temporarily changed `posix_named_semaphore_probe_with_factory` to `return CapabilityProbe(False, "constant unavailable")`, then ran:

```sh
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q -p no:xdist tests/test_sandbox_capabilities_0eba.py::test_posix_named_semaphore_probe_reports_available_when_sem_open_succeeds
```

Output:

```text
FAILED tests/test_sandbox_capabilities_0eba.py::test_posix_named_semaphore_probe_reports_available_when_sem_open_succeeds
E       AssertionError: assert False
E        +  where False = CapabilityProbe(available=False, reason='constant unavailable').available
1 failed in 64.97s (0:01:04)
```

Restored the probe and reran the same test: `1 passed in 1.10s`.

Full sandbox gates:

```sh
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test
```

Output tail:

```text
------------------------ sandbox compatibility skips: 5 ------------------------
POSIX named semaphore unavailable: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted: 4
sandbox ps unavailable: 1
18 failed, 20156 passed, 126 skipped, 22 warnings in 2109.77s (0:35:09)
make: *** [test] Error 1
SEMLOCK_MATCHES=0
```

```sh
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify
```

Output tail:

```text
------------------------ sandbox compatibility skips: 5 ------------------------
POSIX named semaphore unavailable: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted: 4
sandbox ps unavailable: 1
18 failed, 20157 passed, 126 skipped, 21 warnings in 2416.97s (0:40:16)
make: *** [test] Error 1
SEMLOCK_MATCHES=0
```

So `make verify` now runs to completion and exits with a real failure verdict under the sandbox rather than aborting on SemLock; the remaining 18 failures are out of scope for 0eba.

Hosted-run/available-capability comparison:

```sh
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q --collect-only -p no:xdist [4 affected nodeids]
```

Output: all 4 affected nodeids collected. The available-probe pytester regression reports `0 skipped, 4 passed`, proving those marked tests execute rather than skip when the probe reports capability available.

Forbidden-token diff proof:

```sh
git diff | grep -En 'CI|GITHUB_|hostname|getuser' || true
```

Output: no matches.

Mechanism ratchet:

```sh
python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check
```

Output begins `active=682 new=24 increased=0 stale=0` and lists all 24 as `admitted`; no unadmitted mechanisms.

Commit-ticket proof:

```sh
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD
```

Output: `verify-commit-ticket: OK - resolved 0eba-cfd8-34b0-4cb7`.

Push proof:

```text
remote: SUCCESS
remote:   https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2986 tests: skip semaphore-denied multiprocessing cases [NEW]
```
